subject: math
name: Mathematics
course: Multi-Digit Addition, Subtraction & Foundations of Multiplication
title: Grade 2 Mathematics: Multi-Digit Addition, Subtraction & Foundations of Multiplication
overview: Grade 2 mathematics deepens students' conceptual understanding of place value, arithmetic operations, algebraic thinking, measurement, and geometry through rigorous problem-solving routines.
competencies: Demonstrate computational fluency and conceptual flexibility across grade-level operations.
Apply visual models, tape diagrams, and equations to represent and solve multi-step contextual word problems.
Analyze geometric shapes, measurement units, and spatial relationships.
Construct viable mathematical arguments and critique the reasoning of peers.

modules.title: Sums and Differences to 100
modules.description: Building mental math fluency with tens and ones, using number lines and tape diagrams to solve word problems within 100.

topics.title: Make a Ten Strategies Within 100
topics.description: Using compensation and decompose-to-ten mental strategies to add and subtract.

topics.title: Tape Diagrams and Two-Step Word Problems
topics.description: Representing comparison problems with visual tape diagrams and multiple steps.

modules.title: Addition and Subtraction of Length Units
modules.description: Measuring lengths using standard metric (centimeters, meters) and customary (inches, feet) tools, and plotting line plots.

topics.title: Measuring and Estimating with Centimeters and Meters
topics.description: Using rulers, meter sticks, and tape measures to find lengths and estimate.

topics.title: Comparing Lengths and Line Plots
topics.description: Finding the difference in length between two objects and graphing measurement data.

modules.title: Place Value, Counting, and Comparison of Numbers to 1,000
modules.description: Understanding hundreds, tens, and ones in base ten, reading and writing numbers in expanded and standard form to 1000.

topics.title: Bundles of 100 and Base-Ten Structure
topics.description: Representing three-digit values with place value disks, blocks, and expanded form.

topics.title: Comparing Numbers to 1,000
topics.description: Comparing three-digit numbers based on meanings of hundreds, tens, and ones digits.

modules.title: Addition and Subtraction Within 1,000 with Word Problems
modules.description: Adding and subtracting three-digit numbers with regrouping across multiple places using vertical algorithm and place value charts.

topics.title: Vertical Addition with Composing Tens and Hundreds
topics.description: Carrying and bundling 10 ones for a ten, and 10 tens for a hundred.

topics.title: Vertical Subtraction with Unbundling
topics.description: Borrowing and decomposing a hundred into 10 tens, and a ten into 10 ones.

modules.title: Foundations of Multiplication: Equal Groups and Arrays
modules.description: Working with equal groups of objects, rectangular arrays, repeated addition, and introducing odd and even numbers.

topics.title: Odd and Even Numbers
topics.description: Pairing objects and writing equations with two equal addends to determine parity.

topics.title: Rectangular Arrays and Repeated Addition
topics.description: Partitioning rectangles into rows and columns and finding total sums.
